findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 276 requests to 79 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 6.5 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 3.0 MB (46%) came from third-party domains, 1.7 MB of it from services classified as tracking (205 requests).

54 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 2mdn.net (Google, advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), bidr.io (Beeswax, advertising), bidswitch.net (Iponweb (BidSwitch), advertising).
133 cookies were set by third-party domains (168 cookies in total).
